iti86:2.2: vā pana abhinivejjetvā → abhinivajjetvā (bj, sya-all, pts) | vā → pana (sya-all) | yan-ti → dhammānudhammapaṭipanno 'yan-ti only M. and Aa., the other MSS. omit this. iti86:4.1: Caraṁ → paraṁ, D. E.; the first half of this gāthā occurs also sutt. 110, Aṅg.-Nik., Cat.-Nip. 11. (pts note)
